stem.text: The graph shows how the rate of entry of substance X into a cell changes as the concentration of substance X outside the cell increases.

stem.alt: Graph of rate of entry of substance X (y-axis) against concentration of substance X outside the cell (x-axis). The curve rises steeply then levels off to a horizontal plateau.

stem.text: The diagram shows part of a cell surface membrane.

stem.alt: Diagram of part of a cell surface membrane with three labelled arrows numbered 1, 2 and 3 passing through it. Arrows 1 and 2 pass through the bilayer; arrow 3 ends at a protein with an attached carbohydrate branch.

stem.text: Which pathways could substance X use to enter the cell?
